question: To study chemical properties of elements, Mendeleev concentrated on their compounds formed by which two elements?
solution:
The correct answer is __**H and O**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **H and O** are the elements** Mendeleev concentrated** on for studying the **chemical properties of elements.**
 
• Mendeleev's periodic table arranged elements based on their atomic mass and their chemical properties, which were observed through their compounds with **hydrogen (H) and oxygen (O).**
 
• This approach allowed Mendeleev to predict the existence and properties of elements that had not yet been discovered.
 
• By focusing on the compounds formed with hydrogen and oxygen, **Mendeleev was able to highlight the periodicity and similarities in chemical properties among elements.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dmitri Mendeleev** is known as the** father of the periodic table.**
 
• **He published his periodic table in 1869,** which was based on increasing atomic mass and grouped elements with similar properties together.
 
• Mendeleev left gaps in his periodic table for elements that were not yet discovered and predicted their properties based on the trends he observed.
 
• The modern periodic table is based on atomic number rather than atomic mass, but Mendeleev's periodic law laid the foundation for its development.
 
• The periodic table has been expanded and refined over the years as new elements have been discovered and more about atomic structure has been understood.
